Mirza travels to Aleppo to find his nephew and the brother-in-law who abducted him. However, Aleppo will return to Mirza not only Kerem but also Leyla, who has left him in agony for seven years. As Mirza fights a grueling battle to rescue Leyla and 6-year-old Hüma—whom he does not know is his own daughter—from Syria, a fierce struggle against his own family awaits him in Cappadocia.

tt38282411|series.name: A.B.I.: A Broken Inheritance
tt38282411|series.description: Dogan is a successful surgeon in Izmir. When he was young, a shocking incident with his father, Tahir Hancıoglu, caused him to break away from his family. Now devoted to saving lives, Dogan has almost no connection with his family except his younger sister, Melek. At Melek’s insistence, Dogan returns to Istanbul for his sister Gulusan’s wedding. His return brings back long-buried traumas and hidden crimes. Dogan meets Cagla, a strong, determined lawyer. Their painful pasts create a deep connection. The family’s enemy, Behram, watches from the shadows, waiting for the right moment to confront the past. An attempted murder on the wedding night changes everything. Old secrets surface and members of his family appear among the suspects. Dogan must make a choice: leave and return to his old life, or stay and face the truth by uncovering the secrets at the heart of his family.

tt0118414|series.name: The Odyssey

tt0372784|movie.description: After witnessing his parents' death, billionaire Bruce Wayne learns the art of fighting to confront injustice. When he returns to Gotham as Batman, he must stop a secret society that intends to destroy the city.

tt0167261|movie.description: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum, the divided fellowship makes a stand against Sauron's new ally, Saruman, and his hordes of Isengard.

tt0167260|movie.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

tt3065204|movie.name: The Conjuring 2

tt10160976|movie.name: The Nun II

After witnessing the murder of a young student by the secret police, Joan herself becomes the target.

tt6628920|movie.description: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

tt35659725|movie.name: The Legendaries
tt35659725|movie.description: They are brave, intrepid, indomitable, and they turned back to children! While fighting the terrible sorcerer Darkhell, the official heros of Alysia: The Legendaries accidentally broke the Jovenia stone, the one of eternal youth. This is how the whole kingdom of Alysia, and especially our champions, has fallen back into childhood. No more birth, but people keep on dying of accident or sickness… Humanity is then doomed to extinction. A real curse! And quite a blow to the myth of "The Legendaries". The five warriors, formerly admired, have now to lie low… Today blamed and discredited, they are well decided to break the spell and fix their mistake. "Nothing is impossible for a willing heart"… Even at 10!

tt37070354|movie.name: The Storm

tt38504402|movie.name: You, Me, Us
tt38504402|movie.description: A couple faces the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents despite their complex vulnerabilities.

tt37180686|movie.name: Drive - The Pretenders
tt37180686|movie.description: A young race car mechanic pretends to be engaged to the most scandalous racing star in the scene - officially for his reputation, but secretly for her own chance behind the wheel. Soon the lie threatens to destroy everything.

tt38672588|movie.name: Masterplan
tt38672588|movie.description: A master thief enlists two strangers for a Louvre heist targeting the Mona Lisa, then reveals they're his children and siblings who must cooperate to pull off history's greatest art theft.

tt13609648|movie.name: Sense and Sensibility
tt13609648|movie.description: From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen's iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles.

tt33998222|movie.name: Love Language
tt33998222|movie.description: A social media writer starts a wedding vow business, but her world turns upside down when her latest client is engaged to her college crush.

tt43351313|series.name: Possible Love
tt43351313|series.description: Defne, a woman in her thirties, is strong and composed, having built her career through hard work. One day, she realizes just how exhausted and isolated she has become; perhaps the time has come for love. However, two men who enter her life turn everything upside down. Caught between Kadir’s unsettling demeanor and Tolga’s games that shift the balance, Defne finds that nothing will ever be the same again.

tt38987259|series.name: The One I Love
tt38987259|series.description: Erkan Aldur, a young man from a wealthy Istanbul family, is stationed in eastern Turkey to complete his mandatory military service in a remote, earthquake-stricken region. In this harsh and unfamiliar landscape, he meets Dicle, a young woman who has lived her entire life in the village and whose world is shaped by tradition, family, and community. Their encounter brings together two very different worlds, setting in motion a journey of change, resilience, and unexpected connection. As Dicle steps into the unfamiliar and Erkan faces new responsibilities, their story unfolds into a heartfelt and transformative tale of love and courage, that bridges even the widest divides

tt39333720|series.name: Master Omur
tt39333720|series.description: "Ömür Usta," built around family ties, betrayal, love, class conflicts, and second chances, will tell the story of a woman who, despite all her wounds, manages to hold on to life and rediscover her own light.

tt43613803|series.name: Fool Night
tt43613803|series.description: Follows humanity in a future relying on Transfloration technology, which transforms dying humans into plants to combat an oxygen shortage.
